n-k-k2-01.title: Ibsa gareef guutuu
n-k-k2-01.goal: Of-beeksisa ragaa godhii ibsa hundaaf dhugaa ta'uu murteessi, taateewwan hanga meeqa isa cabsu ilaali, ibsa ragaa waliin walsimu barreessi.
n-k-k2-01.material:
Kutaan kee garee haasaa qaba. Kutaan barattoota afur qaba. Tokkoon tokkoon isaanii of-beeksisa gabaabaa nyaata irratti barreessan. Achiis 수진 kutaa irratti hima barreesse.

민호: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 매일 먹어요.
에밀리: 저는 김치를 안 좋아해요. 불고기를 좋아해요.
지아: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 그런데 매운 김치는 못 먹어요.
토마스: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 지난주에 처음 먹었어요.

수진: 우리 반 네 명은 모두 김치를 좋아해요.

(모두 = hunda.)
n-k-k2-01.thinking.2: 'Hin jaalatu' waan biraa irraa adda baasuu
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.prompt: 수진 hiriyoota afur HUNDI kimchi jaallatu jechuun ibsa. Hima hiriyaa kamiin ibsi ishee dhugaa akka hin taane agarsiisa?
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hiriyaa tokkoon tokkoon isaaf, himni kimchi jaallachuu isaanii si beeksisaa murteessi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Himoota 'Nama kun kimchi jaallataa?' jedhu kallattiin deebisan qofa qabadhu, hima 수진 waliin wal bira qabi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.a: Guyyaa guyyaan nyaachuun ibsa deeggara; nama tokko kimchi hin jaalanne agarsiisuu hin danda'u.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.b: Of-beeksisa guutuu ilaali: 지아 illee kimchi jaalachuu ishee jette. Kan hadhaawaa nyaachuu hin dandeessu, kunis kimchi jibbuu waliin wal fakkaataa miti.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.d: Torban darbe yeroo jalqabaaf nyaachuun jaalachuu isaanii irratti waan tokko illee hin jedhu.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.explain: 에밀리 qofti 'Do you like kimchi?' gaaffii lakkii jettee deebisti. Dubbiin waa'ee nama hundaa nama wal hin simne tokkoon cabsama. Himoonni kaan waa'ee hangamii, hangam hadhaawaa, ykn yoom ti, jaalalaa miti.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.prompt: Hima 수진 모두 (hundumaa) jedha. Hima ishee sobaa ta'uuf barattoonni kutaa afran keessaa meeqa wal hin simuu qabu?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kutaan barattoota 100 qaba jedhii yaadi. Namoota kimchi jibban meeqa argachuu qabda?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.1: 'Hundi isaanii jaallatu' nama tokko illee yoo hin hafne qofa dhugaa dha. Wal hin simuun meeqa akka cabsu lakkaa'i.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.a: Lama barbaachisaa ol dha. 'Hundi' nama tokko tokkoof waadaa kenna.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.c: Sadi barbaachisaa ol dha. 'Hundi' nama tokko tokkoof waadaa kenna.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.d: Afur barbaachisaa baay'ee ol dha. 'Hundi jaallatu' nama tokko yeroo hin jaallanne battalumaan dhabama.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.explain: 'Hundi' nama tokko tokkoof waadaa kenna, kanaaf wal hin simuun tokko cabsuuf gahaa dha. Hima akka '대부분' (baay'ee) wal hin simuu muraasa irraa ba'uu danda'a.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.prompt: Hima Koriyaa ulfinaa TOKKO waa'ee kimchi fi barattoota afran barreessi kan ofiin dhaan seensa afran hundumaaf dhugaa ta'u.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dura afran keessaa meeqa kimchi akka jaallatan murteessi, ergasii hima garee sirriitti sanaaf dhugaa ta'u barreessi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Osoo hin xumurin hima kee seensa 에밀리 waliin mirkaneessi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni koo seensa afran HUNDUMAA, 에밀리 dabalatee, dhugaa dhaa?
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wal hin simuu osoo hin maqaa moggaasin 'hundi' irraa fagaadheeraa?

n-k-k2-02.title: Yaadannoon marii waliin ni simataa?
n-k-k2-02.goal: Cuunfaa barreeffame marii kan jalqabaa waliin wal-bira qabi, sararoota bal'ina jijjiiran argi, gosa bal'ina jijjiirame jedhi, fi cuunfaa sirrii barreessi.
n-k-k2-02.material:
민수 fi 지나 Sanbata marii tiin karoorfatu. Ergasii 지나 haadha ishee yaadannoo barreessiti.

민수: 지나 씨, 토요일 오후 두 시에 학교 앞에서 만나요.
민수: 영화는 세 시 반에 시작해요. 영화를 보고 저녁을 먹어요.
민수: 저녁을 먹고 아홉 시에 집에 가요.
지나: 네, 좋아요!

(앞 = fuula dura. 집에 가요 = mana deema.)
n-k-k2-02.prereq.0: Jechoota yeroo Koriyaa (두 시, 아홉 시) ni beeka
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.prompt: 지나 haadha ishee yaadannoo barreessiti. Sararoonni tokko tokko marii waliin hin simatan. Sarara yaadannoo marii waliin hin simatu tokko filadhu.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Yaadannoo sarara tokko tokkoon dabarsi fi bal'ina wal-fakkaataa marii keessatti argi: eenyu, guyyaa kam, eessa, sa'aatii meeqa.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sarara tokko tokkoof, mariin iddoo ykn yeroo kenna moo hin kennine jedhi, fi jechoota tokko tokkoon wal-bira qabi.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.explain: Sararoonni lama marii waliin hin simatan. Sararri 2 isaan fuula dura sinimaa wal-argu jedha, garuu 민수 학교 앞 (fuula dura mana barumsaa) barreesse. Sararri 5 여덟 시 (sa'aatii 8) jedha, garuu 민수 아홉 시 (sa'aatii 9) barreesse. Sararoonni 1, 3 fi 4 ni simatu.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.prompt: Sararoonni dogoggoraa yaadannoo karaa lamaan adda addaan mariirraa adda. Walitti dhufeenyi isaanii kami?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bal'ina karoora gareetti hiri: eenyu, guyyaa kam, eessa, sa'aatii meeqa.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gareewwan lamaan kamtu bal'ina marii fi yaadannoo gidduu jijjiirame qabu?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.a: Guyyaan (토요일) marii fi yaadannoo keessatti wal-fakkaata.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.b: Namni (민수) fi guyyaan (토요일) marii fi yaadannoo keessatti wal-fakkaata.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.r.d: Namni (민수) marii fi yaadannoo keessatti wal-fakkaata.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.explain: Yaadannoon eessa wal-argan (영화관 mannaa 학교) fi yoom mana deeman (여덟 시 mannaa 아홉 시) jijjiira. Eenyu fi guyyaa kam sirrii dha.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.prompt: Yaadannoo haadhaaf Afaan Koriyaa ulfinaa sirriitiin irra deebi'ii barreessi (hima gabaabaa 2 ykn 3). Mariin iddoo wal-argan, yeroo wal-argan, fi yeroo mana deemtu kennuuf fayyadami.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dura bal'ina sadan tarreessi: eessa wal-argan, yoom wal-argan, yoom mana deemtu.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bal'ina tokko tokkoo ergaa 민수 irraa garagalchi fi yeroo tokko tokkoo karoora mataa isaa waliin eegi, ergasii xumura ulfinaa (-요) dabali.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Iddoon fi yeroon yaadannoo koo keessa jiran hundi marii waliin ni simatuu?
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Haati koo eessa fi yoom na eegu beekuu danda'aa?

n-k-k2-03.title: Affeerraa iddoo duwwaa qabu
n-k-k2-03.goal: Dhugaan affeerraa gabaabaa keessaa hanqate kamtu akka ta'e murteessi, deebiin dukkanaa'aan illee gahaa akka hin taane hubadhu, fi wanta si barbaachisu gaafadhu.
n-k-k2-03.material:
Torban darbe 지호 kutaa afaanii keessatti wal-argite. Har'a inni ergaa siif ergee. Gonkumaa mana isaa hin deemne.

지호: 토요일에 우리 집에서 파티를 해요. 꼭 오세요!

(꼭 = maaloo mirkaneessi.)
n-k-k2-03.thinking.1: Wanta barbaachisaa fi wanta beekuu gaarii adda baasuu
n-k-k2-03.prereq.0: Jechoota gaaffii bu'uuraa (몇 시, 어디) ni beeka
n-k-k2-03.prereq.2: 'Nan deema' fi 'galatoomi' Afaan Koriyaa ulfinaa salphaatiin jechuu ni danda'a (갈게요, 고마워요), kunis qajeelfama keessatti ibsameera
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.prompt: Deemuu barbaadda. Gaaffiiwwan kamtu paartii irra ga'uuf dura gaafachuu qabda? Dhugumatti barbaachisan hunda filadhu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ganama Sanbataa dha fi ba'uu barbaadda jedhii yaadi. Maaltu ba'uu si dhorka?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gaaffiiwwan garagaraan baasi: kamtu ga'uuf si gargaara, kamtu beekuuf gaarii qofa dha?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.b: Baay'inni keessummaa dhufan iddoo argachuu ykn yeroo ga'uu hin jijjiiru.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.d: Gaafachuun fayyadaa fi ulfinaa dha, garuu osoo hin beekin ga'uu dandeessa. Ga'uuf hin barbaachisu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.e: Sababa paartii beekuun kennaa filachuuf si gargaara, garuu yoom fi eessa deemuu akka qabdu hin himu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.explain: Ergaan guyyaa (토요일) kenna garuu yeroo hin kennu, fi 우리 집 nama gonkumaa hin daawwanne tiif teessoo hin himu. Yeroo fi iddoon dhugaa ga'uuf barbaachisu lama.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.acc.0: Maal fiduu akka qabdu gaafachuun of-eeggannoo qaba fi sirrii dha. Garuu iddoo fi yeroo sirrii irra ga'uuf hin barbaachisu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.prompt: 지호 gaaffiiwwan kee sarara tokkoon deebisa: '저녁에 오세요.' Amma waa'ee yeroo gahaa beekta?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Jechi 저녁 sa'aatii meeqa hammachuu danda'a yaadi.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Of gaafadhu: keessummaan lama hima kana dubbisanii sa'aatii sadiin adda ta'anii ga'uu danda'uu?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.a: Eyyee. 저녁 yeroo dha, kanaaf galgala keessatti yeroo kamiyyuu dhufuu nan danda'a.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.a: 저녁 (galgala) sa'aatii hedduu hammata. Yoo booda ga'te, jalqaba dhabuu dandeessa; yoo dura ga'te, nama tokko illee qophaa'ee hin jiraachuu danda'a.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.b: Ammaaf miti. 저녁 sa'aatii hedduu hammata, kanaaf amma illee sa'aatii sirrii barbaada.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.c: Eyyee. Guyyaa fi kutaa guyyaa beeka, kanaaf ga'uu koo karoorfachuu nan danda'a.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.c: Guyyaa fi kutaa guyyaa yeroo ga'umsaa sirrii amma illee hin ta'an.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.d: Ammaaf miti. 저녁 'nyaata galgalaa' jechuu dha, kanaaf nyaanni dhiyaata moo hin dhiyaatu gaafachuu qaba.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.d: 저녁 'galgala' ykn 'nyaata galgalaa' jechuu danda'a. Asitti jecha yeroo dha 에 fi 오세요 irraa, fi nyaanni yoom ga'uu akka qabdu hin himu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.explain: 저녁 kutaa guyyaa qofa maqaa moggaasa. Yeroo sirrii ga'uuf amma illee sa'aatii barbaachisa, fakkeenyaaf 여섯 시.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.0: Isa galateeffachuun ykn dhufa jechuun jalqabi (고마워요 = galatoomi, 갈게요 = nan deema).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.1: Dhugaan tarree gaaffii kee duraa keessaa kamtu nama mana ba'uu dura barbaachisa? Xumura ulfinaa (-요) tiin gaafadhu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Deebiin koo nama torban darbe qofa argadhe tiif gahaa ulfinaa dha?

n-k-k2-04.title: Kuusaa seera qabu
n-k-k2-04.goal: Haalawwan hedduu marii bitaa gabaabaa keessatti dubbisi, ergasii kuusaa tokko caalaa haalawwan hundumaa guutu ijaari, fi kuusaa tokko Afaan Koriyaatiin gabaasi.
n-k-k2-04.material:
민지: 오늘 시장에서 과일을 사요. 사과는 한 개에 천 원, 귤은 한 개에 오백 원이에요.
민지: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요. 그런데 사과가 귤보다 적어요.
민지: 과일은 모두 일곱 개 이상 사요. 오천 원을 넘으면 안 돼요.

(이상 = lakkoofsa kana ykn isa caalaa. 넘으면 안 돼요 = darbuu hin qabu. -보다 = caalaa.)
n-k-k2-04.thinking.2: Daangaan deebii hedduu akka hayyamu hubachuu
n-k-k2-04.prereq.0: Lakkoofsa hanga kuma (천, 오백) ni beeka
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.prompt: Ergaa 민지 lammaffaa keessatti, '사과가 귤보다 적어요' waa'ee kuusaa maal siif jedha?
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Muduraan kamtu mata-duree (가 tiin mallatteeffame) fi mudurri kamtu waliin wal-bira qabamu (보다 tiin mallatteeffame) argi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.1: 적어요 'hanga xiqqaa dha' jedhii dubbisi fi mudurri kamtu hanga xiqqaa akka qabu murteessi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.a: 적어요 'xiqqaa / gadi' jechuu dha. -보다 wanta wal-bira qabamu mallatteessa, kanaaf apple lakkoofsa xiqqaa dha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.b: Himni hanga lama wal-bira qaba fi tokko xiqqaa jedha; wal-qixa hin jedhu.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.o.d: Kuusaa keessa apple tokko illee hin jiru.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.d: Sararri duraa 사과도 사고 jedha, kanaaf apple kuusaa keessa jira; 적어요 'xiqqaa' jedha, 'homaa hin jiru' miti.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.explain: A (사과가) B (귤보다) 적어요 = A B caalaa xiqqaa dha. Kanaaf baay'inni apple tangerine caalaa xiqqaa dha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.prompt: Nama tokko apple 3 fi tangerine 5 yaada. Kuusaan kun haala 민지 kamtu cabsa?
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Haalawwan tokko tokkoon lakkoofsa 3 fi 5 tiin qoradhu.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Haala maallaqaaf, gatii apple fi gatii tangerine adda herregi, ergasii ida'i.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.b: Apple 3 tangerine 5 caalaa xiqqaa dha, kanaaf haalli kun sirrii dha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.c: 3 + 5 = 8 muduraa, kunis 7 ykn isaa ol dha, kanaaf kun sirrii dha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.d: Kuusaan apple fi tangerine lamaanuu qaba, kanaaf kun sirrii dha.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.explain: Apple 3 won 3,000 gatii qaba fi tangerine 5 won 2,500 gatii qaba, walitti won 5,500. Kun 5,000 ol dha. Haalawwan sadan kaan guutamaniiru.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.prompt: Kuusaa adda addaa 3 ergaa 민지 keessa haala HUNDUMAA guutu argi. a = baay'ina apple (사과), t = baay'ina tangerine (귤).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Dura haalawwan jechoota mataa keetiin kaa'i: apple tangerine caalaa xiqqaa, xiqqaan muduraa 7, baay'inaan won 5,000.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Apple 1 yaali fi baay'ina tangerine xiqqaan muduraa 7 godhu argi; ergasii gatii mirkaneessi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.2: Maallaqa dhumarratti mirkaneessi: 1,000 x apple + 500 x tangerine, ergasii baay'ina apple jijjiiri.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c0: Mudura guutuu qofa bitadhu (lakkoofsa guutuu 개).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c1: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요: xiqqaan tokko tokko.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c2: 사과가 귤보다 적어요: apple tangerine caalaa xiqqaa ta'uu qaba.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c3: 일곱 개 이상: waliigalatti xiqqaan mudura 7.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c4: Waliigalli won 5,000 ol dha (apple tokko won 1,000, tangerine tokko won 500).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.explain: Fakkeenyaaf apple 1 + tangerine 7 = won 4,500; 2 + 5 = won 4,500; 3 + 4 = won 5,000. Kuusaan baay'ee simata sababni ergaawwan daangaa kennan malee ajaja sirrii tokko hin kennine.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Kuusaa kee keessaa TOKKO filadhu fi 민지 ergaa ulfinaa gabaabaan apple fi tangerine meeqa akka bitu fi gatii waliigalaa himi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Tarree olii irraa kuusaa tokko fudhadhu fi lakkoofsa isaa lama barreessi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Dura apple, ergasii tangerine, ergasii waliigala won jedhi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Lakkoofsonni ergaa koo kuusaa ani ijaare tokko waliin ni simatuu?
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Waliigalli sirrii dhaa (1,000 x apple + 500 x tangerine)?

n-k-k2-05.title: Eenyutu godhe? Himni hin jedhu
n-k-k2-05.goal: Marii gabaabaa mata-duree dhiisu hordofi, akkamitti dubbisni kee eenyutu maal godhe jedhu jijjiiramuu hubadhu, fi hima tokko irra deebi'ii barreessi akka nama tokko illee dogoggoraan hin dubbifne.
n-k-k2-05.material: 하나 hiriyaa ishee 준호 waliin waa'ee dhuma torbanii darbee dubbatti. Afaan Koriyaa keessatti mata-dureen yeroo ifa fakkaatu dhiifama. Suuta dubbisi: seenaan kutaa sadiin dhufa.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.prompt: Kutaa hundaa dubbisi, dubbisa carraa caalaa qabu filadhu, achiis itti fufi. Yeroo dabalaa dubbistu deebiin kee jijjiiramuu danda'a.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Wanta hanga ammaa dubbiste qofa fayyadamuun murteessi.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Jechoonni maqaa nama kennan fi gochimoonni nama itti maxxanfame hin qabne kam akka ta'an ilaali.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Hima lammaffaan dhimma (subject) hin qabu. Afaan Koreaa yeroo baayyee dhimma haala keessaa ifa ta'e dhiisa, asitti garuu obboleessi xiqqaan (동생이) nama dhumaa maqaa isaa dhahame dha, 하나 immoo dubbataa dha, kanaaf yeroo kana mirkaneessuu hin dandeessu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Himni 만들었어요 jedha, kanaaf nama tokko hojjate, garuu namoonni seenaa keessa jiran 하나 fi obboleessa/obboleettii ishee xiqqaa qofa.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 하나 ofumaa hojjachuu danda'a, garuu gaaffii dandeettii obboleessa/obboleettii ishee irratti deebise, kanaaf ammayyuu dubbisa danda'amu qofa dha.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 하나 obboleessi/obboleettiin ishee kaa'uu hin danda'u jedha, kanaaf kun hin danda'amu, garuu eenyutu bilcheesse ammayyuu hin jenne.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kutaan jalqabaa 만들었어요 (hojjate) jedha, kanaaf nama tokko bilcheesse.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Deebiin ishee waa'ee dandeettii obboleessa/obboleettii dha. Nyaata bilcheessuu waliin qooddeen jedhu hin jedhu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 먹었어요 ammas dhimma (subject) hin qabu. Baayyee uumamaa 하나 dha, obboleessa/obboleettii waliin ta'uu danda'a. Yeroo nama tokko ifatti mallatteeffame (동생이 했어요), mallattoon eenyu akka ta'e sitti himu; yeroo homaa hin mallatteeffamne, haala fayyadamuu qabda yeroo tokko tokko immoo gaafachuu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 하나 nama 제가 만들었어요 jedhe dha; homaan obboleessa/obboleettii qofa nama nyaate hin mallatteessu. 설거지는 동생이 mallattoo qaba, 먹었어요 garuu hin qabu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 맛있게 먹었어요 nyaatame fi itti gammadame jedha.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.reflect: Afaan Koreaa dhimma (subject) yeroo haalli kennu dhiisa, garuu nama dhumaa waa'ee isaa dubbiste yeroo hundaa gocha itti aanu raawwatu miti. Mallattoowwan (이/가, 은/는, 제가) barbaadi, homaa yoo hin mallatteeffamne dubbisa banaa eegi. Yoo barbaachise, gaafadhu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.prompt: Hima jalqabaa lamaan 하나 Afaan Koreaa kabajaa qabuun deebi'ii barreessi akka namni tokkoyyuu eenyutu bibimbap hojjate dogoggoraan hin dubbifne: 하나 ofumaa ture, akkuma haasaa keessatti barte. Isa jalqabaa: 어제 동생이 우리 집에 왔어요. 비빔밥을 만들었어요.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Hima kee isa jalqabaa wajjin wal bira qabi: hima lammaffaaf odeeffannoon kamtu hafe?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Mallattoo maqaa nama booda (-가 / -이) nama sun gocha raawwate agarsiisa.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Dubbisaan haasaa osoo hin ilaalin eenyutu bibimbap hojjate beekuu danda'aa?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Obboleessi/obboleettiin koo mana kootti dhufuu isaa ammayyuu jedheera?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Nama hin hojjanne illee maqaa kenna.
